subject: Superbrain P0 authoritative verification and cold-start repair

project_context.current_objective: Obtain an authoritative Superbrain Gate GREEN on the repaired main state while preserving the protected GREEN boundary and proving clean cold-start restoration.

naya.title: Superbrain P0 Verification — Naya Note
naya.summary: The P0 verification pass repaired the canonical Smart Note corpus, corrected clean-checkout gate ordering, and obtained authoritative GREEN proof. Subsequent authoritative runs exposed and repaired a cold-start fixture race, a verified-event schema mismatch, and a machine-parseable Next Execution handoff gap. The validator remained intact throughout.
lessons: Strict acceptance tests should run before the side effects they are intended to measure.
A failing acceptance test is valuable evidence; preserve it, identify the root cause, and repair the boundary rather than weakening the validator.
Repository state, generated artifacts, and authoritative CI evidence must remain distinguishable.
Evidence promotion must preserve the canonical event schema exactly.
Human-readable handoffs must also expose the machine-readable contract fields required by the validator.
next_best_actions: Obtain a fresh authoritative brain-gate on the corrected continuity state.
Inspect every substantive step and record exact evidence.
If GREEN, begin P1 Universal Canonical Event-Write Adoption.

shawn.title: Superbrain P0 Verification — Shawn/Smart Note
shawn.summary: The brain keeps doing exactly what we want: it catches bookkeeping and contract drift instead of letting us call something green. We fixed each real source defect and reran the authoritative gate. The latest blocker is the P0 event's continuity execution state, which must be COMPLETED when verification is VERIFIED.
lessons: Proof is only proof when the test observes the condition it claims to test.
The smartest repair preserves the validator and fixes the source or execution order.
A canonical event must remain canonical even when its verification state changes.
A ready-to-run Next Execution is part of completion, not optional paperwork.
The next Naya should inherit failures and the lessons they taught us.
next_best_actions: Run the authoritative gate on the corrected event state.
Show the real logs and receipt.
Then begin the highest-value P1 caller-adoption work.

lessons: Clean acceptance boundaries must precede generated evidence artifacts.
The next Naya should inherit both the fix and the reason for the fix.
